sec.t: ff.102.1 The future doesn't go on holiday
sec.p: Matt Clancy's newsletter (an innovation-and-society researcher at Iowa University) is called What’s New Under the Sun.

sec.t: ff.102.2 Wuhan: from Covid to Baidu
sec.p: As you'll have guessed, we're talking about positivity. Not for COVID, even though I'm taking you somewhere well known.
Founded in Tokyo by ex-Google employees, Sakana AI has unveiled its AI Scientist: a system to automate scientific discovery that generates ideas, runs experiments and writes scientific papers.
Let's carry on with our roundup of autonomous systems. Did somebody say drones?
Social media and the digital world could soon disappear, swamped by uncertain content. Fake.
